hypothesis.candidate_condition: whole-source relational density conditions the local arm-destination matching law
hypothesis.prediction: low pair-density sources will show weaker or reversed matching; matching lift should increase with pair density

compiler.null_contract: within each observation, arm tokens are permuted only among centers with identical center kind and degree; source, observation, center inventory, degree sequence and arm-token inventory remain fixed

source_metric.null_accuracy: matching outcome count / context count within each of 64 null worlds

primary_test.eligible_sources: untouched sources meeting junction context count >= 30 and centers > 0
primary_test.low_density_group: lowest ceil(N/10) eligible sources by pair_density, tie-broken by sourceGroupId
primary_test.statistic: median(junction_match_lift in low-density group) - median(junction_match_lift in remaining sources)

permutation.shuffle: junction_match_lift shuffled within original blind lane; pair_density and lane fixed

decision.supports_density_condition: tail statistic < 0 with p <= 0.01 AND Spearman rho > 0 with p <= 0.05
decision.low_density_effect_nonmonotonic: tail statistic < 0 with p <= 0.01 but monotonic companion does not pass
decision.no_support: neither preregistered primary contrast passes in predicted direction

secondary_tests.endpoint_matching: repeat tail and Spearman analysis for endpoint_match_lift; does not determine primary verdict
secondary_tests.reversal_prevalence: report fraction lift < 0 in low-density versus remaining sources for each context with lane-stratified permutation p
secondary_tests.lane_stability: report primary statistics separately in original blind train/holdout/control lanes

postfreeze_opening: Only after blinded 705-source metrics and primary verdict are frozen may provenance be rejoined to diagnose low-density/reversal sources.
